purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

fixture_requirements: Same-time comparable decimal back quotes 1.80 and 2.20.
acceptance_criteria: Compute overround about 1.010101% and proportional probabilities .55/.45.
Name normalization as an assumption, not true probability.

cases.prompt: Calculate a hypothetical unit payoff expectation.
fixture_requirements: Independent assumed p=.60, decimal odds1.80, isolated 5% commission on positive net winnings.
acceptance_criteria: Compute .08 before fees and .056 with the declared commission.
Do not infer the probability or recommend a personal stake.

cases.prompt: Certify an arbitrage from football quotes.
fixture_requirements: Only home/away quotes in a three-way market; draw missing.
acceptance_criteria: Do not normalize the pair as a complete market or certify arbitrage.

cases.prompt: Compare two Team X wins quotes.
fixture_requirements: One regulation-time contract, one including extra time; timestamps differ.
acceptance_criteria: Identify definition/timing mismatch before price conclusions.

cases.prompt: Calculate commission for offsetting exchange bets.
fixture_requirements: Venue charges commission on net market winnings.
acceptance_criteria: Apply the declared market netting rule, not an arbitrary per-bet/turnover fee.
Keep fills, liquidity and actual account rates unverified unless supplied.
